thesis: The podcast argues that the mainstream media era where institutions controlled free speech has ended, replaced by an uncontrolled information environment where value has shifted from institutional brands to individual voices. It explains that a16z invested in Substack to enable writers to monetize directly, creating a supply of content that pulls new demand into existence, while noting that the US has substantially restored free speech compared to other regions trying to lock it down.
